title: First jazz gig nerves and Kenny Dorham's reckless driving
summary: Sam is scared playing next to Paul Chambers, and Dorham crashes his convertible while fleeing state troopers.

story.theme_name: Illness, injury and the deaths of colleagues
story.community_name: Illness, injury and death among jazz musicians

blocks.x: You know, played all the music. And Arthur Edgehill was on the drums. He played OK. I was just-- that was my first uh, like I said, first jazz gig, man, and I was excited and scared to death, man. Cause Paul Chambers, boy, that fellow had me uptight there, boy. Good God, give me some room to breathe in here, man. Let me relax. And so Kenny had--I'd like you to know he was a fast driver, you know. He had a convertible Ford. He bought himself a convertible--convertible, man. And so we was supposed to be playing in ah, up in Pennsylvania somewhere up in there. And he picked up a girl to go with him cause nobody wouldn't ride in the car with him after the trip from Cleveland. I swore I wasn't never going to get in the car with him no more. And so he was trying to outrun the State Troopers.
And he tried to straighten out a curb.
Yeah. Heard this--I think the girl got really messed up pretty bad in that car accident.
